title: Nana Hy Ay Sochan Rendiya Nay Bemaar Nu
body:
Kadon Aawan Gaye Watna Tay Kadon Veeran Shakal Wakhawan Gaye Ghamkaar Nu.
<<DIVIDER>>
Teray Deway Roz Jalawa Roro Arz Guzara Raat Walay Kurlawa
Teray Deway Roz Jalawa
Kado Muknay Nay Ronay Kadon Ah Kay Seenay Laway Gah Lachaar Nu.
<<DIVIDER>>
May Mintan Kardi Ray Gaye Mehmal Tay Vi Bay Gaye Akbar Akhay Lay Gaye
May Mintan Kardi Ray Gaye
Naye Bhul Sakdi O Waila May Naye Bhul Sakdi Babay Day Inkaar Nu.
<<DIVIDER>>
Nana Mainu Khwaab Darawan Zakhmi Seena Wakhawan Naizay Samnay Aawan
Nana Mainu Khwaab Darawan
Mainu Disdiya Nay Phuphiya Gal Lakay Rondiya Babay Di Dastaar Nu.
<<DIVIDER>>
Masooma Nu May Takiya Chehra Khoo Naal Bharia Haath Rukhsaar Tay Rakiya
Masooma Nu May Takiya
Pay Roro Kay O Ujaari Dariya Tay Wajan Maar Di Alamdaar Nu.
<<DIVIDER>>
Saqlain Karay Aay Duawa Jag Tay Sariya Bhena Jeewan Naal Bhirawa
Saqlain Karay Aay Duawa
Koyi Bhain Kaadi Na Tarsay Jevay Tarsi Sughra Veeran Day Dedaar Nu.
